about: Binds the shipped evidence by hash and states which checks pass and which do NOT. It is deliberately not a claim of algorithmic success at fixture scale or otherwise: the shipped arm's measured success probability is below the floor and is recorded as failing.

assert_notes.a_numerator_probe_excluded_as_invalid: the a=-3 numerator-only probe gives verified/meets=0.0057 and is excluded from every claim; see evidence/a_shift.json.
assert_notes.claim_is_ceiling: 131.6873 is the 4-dp ceiling of 131.6872366, so the at-most direction holds.
assert_notes.doubling_branch_never_fires: 0 doubling events in 18019189440 measured walker-steps (both a=0 arms), and 2^-128.4 expected at production, so the a=-3 numerator is never evaluated.
assert_notes.pair_census_protocol_two_runs_fresh_coin: one challenge per set, run 2 only on run-1 failure, fresh walker coins per run, CP95 lower on the measured set fraction.
assert_notes.success_ge_floor_shipped_arm: FALSE, and it is why this package is not promotable. Shipped arm p2=0.07050, CP95 lower 0.06514, against the 0.39 floor. The control arm is 0.45583 / 0.44519 and does meet it; the control is NOT the shipped walk and is not claimed as such.

not_certified: success at or above 0.39 for the shipped arm
any extrapolation law beyond the measured cells
that the guard is repairable without changing the transition
a prime-order a=-3 fixture (Schoof counting not performed)
